mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_team( team_id, activity_id, initiator_user_id, target_count, complete_count, lock_count, status, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, notify_url, create_time, update_time ) values( #{teamId}, #{activityId}, #{initiatorUserId}, #{targetCount}, #{completeCount}, #{lockCount}, #{status}, #{validStartTime}, #{validEndTime}, #{notifyUrl}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update group_buy_team set lock_count = lock_count + 1, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and lock_count < target_count
update group_buy_team set complete_count = complete_count + 1, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and complete_count < target_count
update group_buy_team set status = 1, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 0
mapper.select: select id, team_id, activity_id, initiator_user_id, target_count, complete_count, lock_count, status, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, notify_url, create_time, update_time from group_buy_team where team_id = #{teamId} limit 1
